Data for the Stan program of a kernel

Source: R/codegen.R
kernel_standata.Rd

The data list for the program written by kernel_stancode().

Usage

kernel_standata(
  kernel,
  tree,
  y,
  X = NULL,
  se = NULL,
  use_prior = 1,
  prior_sigma_scale = NULL,
  prior_beta_scale = NULL,
  repeated = NULL
)

Arguments

kernel

A kernel.

tree

A phylo tree, or the output of tree_info().

y

Response vector in the tip order of tree.

X

Design matrix in the same order (default: intercept only).

se

Known measurement-error standard deviations (default 0).

use_prior

0 for maximum likelihood (no priors), 1 for Bayesian.

prior_sigma_scale

Optional scale of the half-normal priors on the component scales; by default 2 sd(y) / sqrt(base variance).

prior_beta_scale

Optional scale of the normal priors on the regression coefficients.

repeated

For several observations per species: NULL, or a list with n (observations per species, in tip order), species (tip index of each observation), y_dev and X_dev (deviations of the response and of the design matrix from their species means) and sd_y (sd of the response over observations). y and X are then species means.

Value

A named list.
